name: Settlement Details 230
definition: Details of settlement of a transaction.

SecuritiesTransactionType.name: Securities Transaction Type
SecuritiesTransactionType.definition: Identifies the type of securities transaction.

SettlementTransactionCondition.name: Settlement Transaction Condition
SettlementTransactionCondition.definition: Conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.

BeneficialOwnership.name: Beneficial Ownership
BeneficialOwnership.definition: Specifies whether there is change of beneficial ownership.

CCPEligibility.name: CCP Eligibility
CCPEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is CCP (Central Counterparty) eligible.

CashClearingSystem.name: Cash Clearing System
CashClearingSystem.definition: Specifies the category of cash clearing system, for example, cheque clearing.

ExposureType.name: Exposure Type
ExposureType.definition: Specifies the underlying business area/type of trade causing the collateral movement.

FXStandingInstruction.name: FX Standing Instruction
FXStandingInstruction.definition: Specifies whether the forex standing instruction in place should apply.

MarketClientSide.name: Market Client Side
MarketClientSide.definition: Specifies if an instruction is for a market side or a client side transaction.

NettingEligibility.name: Netting Eligibility
NettingEligibility.definition: Specifies whether the settlement transaction is eligible for netting.

Registration.name: Registration
Registration.definition: Specifies whether registration should occur upon receipt.

LegalRestrictions.name: Legal Restrictions
LegalRestrictions.definition: Regulatory restrictions applicable to a security.

SettlingCapacity.name: Settling Capacity
SettlingCapacity.definition: Role of a party in the settlement of the transaction.

TaxCapacity.name: Tax Capacity
TaxCapacity.definition: Tax role capacity of the instructing party.

StampDutyTaxBasis.name: Stamp Duty Tax Basis
StampDutyTaxBasis.definition: Specifies the stamp duty type or exemption reason applicable to the settlement transaction.

Tracking.name: Tracking
Tracking.definition: Specifies whether the loan and/or collateral is tracked.

LetterOfGuarantee.name: Letter Of Guarantee
LetterOfGuarantee.definition: Specifies whether physical settlement may be executed using a letter of guarantee or if the physical certificates should be used.

ReturnLeg.name: Return Leg
ReturnLeg.definition: Indicates whether, for a securities lending/borrowing settlement transaction, the lender will instruct the return leg as agreed with the borrower.

ModificationCancellationAllowed.name: Modification Cancellation Allowed
ModificationCancellationAllowed.definition: Specifies whether a third party is allowed to modify or cancel the transaction.

EligibleForCollateral.name: Eligible For Collateral
EligibleForCollateral.definition: Specifies whether securities should be included in the pool of securities eligible for collateral purposes.

SecuritiesSubBalanceType.name: Securities Sub Balance Type
SecuritiesSubBalanceType.definition: Specifies the securities sub balance type indicator (example restriction type for a market infrastructure).

CashSubBalanceType.name: Cash Sub Balance Type
CashSubBalanceType.definition: Specifies the cash sub balance type indicator, for example, the restriction type for a market infrastructure.

SettlementDetailsElementsUsageRule.definition: Conditions of use of the codes for the SettlementDetails field must be pre-agreed between account owner and account servicer.

CashSettlementSystemUsageRule.definition: Cash settlement system codes are to be used only by agents directly involved in the settlement process, such as local settlement agents, CSDs and central banks.
